video_title: Homemade: Ace Bailey's ascent from Chattanooga, TN to the NBA

quotes.speaker: Montreal Beasley
quotes.summary_phrase: Montreal Beasley on the community support that shaped Ace Bailey
quotes.excerpt: Ace had a great village. His village was this community center.
quotes.quote: Ace had a great village. His village was this community center, it was his mom, it was his teachers at school, it was Cedric. It was a number of people throughout his life that really kept him in line and kept him focused to get to where he is.

quotes.speaker: Felicion McMillon
quotes.summary_phrase: Felicion McMillon on Ace Bailey's need for movement in class
quotes.excerpt: He was a student that needed to move, so being able to have dance was very important.
quotes.quote: He was an amazing bright student. Ace really enjoyed my class because he needed to move. He was a student that needed to move, so being able to have dance was very important.

quotes.speaker: Ace Bailey
quotes.summary_phrase: Ace Bailey on the business realities of professional basketball
quotes.excerpt: Once you get where I'm at, it's a business. Everybody looks at you as a business.
quotes.quote: Enjoy the game, because once you get where I'm at, it's a business. Everybody looks at you as a business. And how you act now can predict your future ahead.

quotes.speaker: Rod McGee
quotes.summary_phrase: Rod McGee on the importance of discipline and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: If you don't do this and you don't do that, you're not going to be good at nothing.
quotes.quote: I used to let him know that if you don't do this and you don't do that, you're not going to be good at nothing. If you're not good at nothing, there's only one place you can go. So I used to be real hard on him about doing the right thing and don't get nobody nothing to say about you.
